source: Bhutan designs to the Indian Standards (parent pack is-codes): zone = the IS zone number (IV, V as 4, 5 in zoneCoefficients) as Bhutan applies the IS 1893 map, western Bhutan zone IV and central, eastern and south-eastern Bhutan zone V (SAEngine reading, to be checked); Vb [m/s] of IS 875 (Part 3):2015 read at the adjoining Indian regions (47 m/s West Bengal and Sikkim side, 50 m/s Assam side).
